definitions.explanation: The lower edge of a garment, especially the part that can be adjusted in length.
The lower slopes or base area of a mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾|すそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦すぎる→すぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: The hem of the skirt is too long.

examples.japanese: ⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾|すそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

examples.english: There's a small village at the foot of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {裾|すそ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}きずって→引きずる：06045_hikizuru⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裾野|すその}→裾野：10376_susono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Wide grasslands stretch out at the foot of Mount Fuji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裾野|すその}→裾野：10376_susono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧な⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{登|のぼ}り→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The mountain has such wide slopes at the base that it took a long time just to reach the start of the climb.

notes:
CLOTHING USAGE:
・{裾|すそ}を{上|あ}げる - to shorten the hem, to hem up
・{裾|すそ}を{下|お}ろす - to let down the hem
・{裾|すそ}{直|なお}し - hemming, alteration
・{裾上|すそあ}げ - hemming service

GEOGRAPHICAL USAGE:
・{山|やま}の{裾|すそ} - foot of a mountain
・{裾野|すその} - mountain slopes, skirts (also a place name)

IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS:
・{裾|すそ}を{広|ひろ}げる - to expand (a scope, fan base)
・{裾野|すその}が{広|ひろ}い - to have a wide base of support

RELATED CLOTHING PARTS:
・{襟|えり} - collar
・{袖|そで} - sleeve
・{丈|たけ} - length (of clothing)
